openQuestions.title: Label the TextDecoderStream fallback instead of claiming textStream()
openQuestions.detail: The sibling streaming-text-reader already prints '⚠ textStream() not supported; falling back…'. This page must do the same: when hasTS is false, the log should say the fallback path is running (and ideally the sibling feature-detect verdict), not '2. Getting textStream()…'. As written, every non-151 visitor sees a fake textStream success.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: 'Run pipeline' printed 'Getting textStream()… Pipeline complete' and produced uppercase output — but feature-detect on the sibling page proves textStream is undefined here; source confirms a silent body.pipeThrough(TextDecoderStream) fallback with no label. Fake-success on unsupported builds; zero console errors.
